title: Optional alert on REST API Upload error
symptom: Users want an optional alert after a number of consecutive REST API Upload errors to inform them of potential network problems when uploading data to Nightscout or their OpenAPS rig. Additionally, the API error remains on the status screen for hours even after uploading has subsequently succeeded.
fix: The feature was added in the 16th Aug nightly, with an extra option to turn the alerts on/off from the Rest API cloud upload settings page. The alert is raised after a number of consecutive missed uploads, but the threshold is not configurable in the thread.
evidence_quote: The 16th Aug nightly now has this feature. It appears to work well in my local testing, please let me know. There is an extra option to turn the alerts on/off from the Rest API cloud upload settings page.
